# PGN binding {#sec-binding-pgns}

[Normative]{.status}

## Overview

PGNs are the parameter groups defined by NMEA 2000, each identified by a Parameter Group Number.
This binding covers PGNs on every transport that carries them:

NMEA 2000
: The CAN-based network connecting instruments, displays and machinery on board.

OneNet
: NMEA's standard for networks on board over IP.
  It is link-local, and carries PGNs with longer messages than NMEA 2000 where needed.

This binding is how framework information reaches current-generation displays, and how vessel data enters the framework for sharing and recording.
